dedupe_keys.name: dam binran タム便覧 japan dam foundation dam information site

description: Dam Binran is the dam information site run by the Japan Dam Foundation. Dams of Japan can be browsed by region and prefecture, with a page per dam, and a world section lists notable dams by country. Each Japanese dam page gives a specification block with the left bank location and coordinates, river system, height, crest length and embankment volume, purpose codes and dam type, catchment and reservoir area, total and effective storage, the owner, the main contractors, and start and completion years, followed by a change history of these values across yearbook editions, notes on related legislation and construction milestones, dam cards and user columns. Coverage is dams in Japan, with a smaller set of world dams. Access is free online as HTML pages, mostly in Japanese. Caveats: there is no bulk download or stated licence, the site notes that some information may be out of date, and much content is contributed by users. Simulation uses: dam and reservoir attributes for flood control and water supply models and dam failure exposure. Related records: MLIT dam statistics (data-japan-mlit-dam-statistics-database) and the ICOLD World Register of Dams (data-icold-world-register-of-dams).
